sentences.en: Ah, super complicated.

sentences.en: So more complicated than it ought to be.

sentences.en: In the United States, recycling programs vary depending on individual cities, counties, and states.
sentences.zh: 在美国，回收项目因各个城市、县和州而异。

sentences.en: We don't have a national recycling policy.
sentences.zh: 我们没有国家回收政策。

sentences.en: Other countries do in a variety of ways.
sentences.zh: 其他国家以各种方式制定了政策。

sentences.en: Here in the U.S.,
sentences.zh: 而在美国这里，

sentences.en: we do not.
sentences.zh: 我们没有。

sentences.en: So in the wake of National Sword, it's been up to each individual recycling program
sentences.zh: 因此，在“国剑”行动之后，只能由每个独立的回收项目

sentences.en: to find new buyers wherever they can.
sentences.zh: 去任何能找到的地方寻找新的买家。

sentences.en: Some have started selling their recyclables to Southeast Asia,
sentences.zh: 一些人开始把可回收物卖给东南亚，

sentences.en: countries like Vietnam and Malaysia and Thailand.
sentences.zh: 比如越南、马来西亚和泰国这样的国家。

sentences.en: Others are finding domestic markets,
sentences.zh: 另一些人则在寻找国内市场，

sentences.en: at least for certain materials.
sentences.zh: 至少对于某些材料是这样。

sentences.en: With aluminum and with plastic and paper mills, you know, there are places in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 对于铝、塑料和造纸厂，你知道的，美国国内有一些地方

sentences.en: to send this
sentences.zh: 可以把这些东西送过去，

sentences.en: that will buy this material to make new products with it.
sentences.zh: 他们会买下这些材料来制造新产品。

sentences.en: And so with that in mind, areas of the
sentences.zh: 因此，考虑到这一点，国内

sentences.en: country that have an end market in reasonable distance, they're doing okay.
sentences.zh: 在合理距离内有终端市场的地区，目前过得还算不错。

sentences.en: And now there's a big push to invest more in domestic recycling infrastructure, which is good.
sentences.zh: 现在人们大力推动对国内回收基础设施的更多投资，这很好。

sentences.en: There's over a dozen announcements of either new or expanded paper mills happening in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 美国有十多起新建或扩建造纸厂的公告发布。

sentences.en: But here's the thing.
sentences.zh: 但问题是这样的。

sentences.en: All these new plastic, glass, and paper mills will not save us.
sentences.zh: 所有这些新的塑料、玻璃和造纸厂都拯救不了我们。

sentences.en: Because now
sentences.zh: 因为现在

sentences.en: they are getting so inundated with recyclables that they're increasingly putting their own
sentences.zh: 它们收到的可回收物实在是太多了，以至于它们对愿意接受的

sentences.en: restrictions on what kinds of materials they're willing to accept.
sentences.zh: 材料种类施加了越来越多的限制。

sentences.en: And there's a good reason why all these places started turning away our recycling.
sentences.zh: 所有这些地方开始拒绝我们的回收物，是有充分理由的。

sentences.en: The stuff we'd been sending them was too dirty.
sentences.zh: 我们一直送过去的东西太脏了。

sentences.en: So much of what we throw into the recycling bin is filthy, contaminated with liquids or food
sentences.zh: 我们扔进回收箱的很多东西都很肮脏，被液体、食物

sentences.en: waste or oil.
sentences.zh: 残渣或油污污染了。

sentences.en: And this kind of contamination just ruins the material.
sentences.zh: 这种污染简直毁了这些材料。

sentences.en: So if you're the anal one in your house who's rinsing the yogurt out of the yogurt containers
sentences.zh: 所以，如果你是你家里那个在扔酸奶盒之前

sentences.en: before you throw them out, you are right.
sentences.zh: 把里面的酸奶冲洗干净的强迫症，你是对的。

sentences.en: You are doing it right.
sentences.zh: 你这样做是对的。

sentences.en: But most people haven't been doing it right.
sentences.zh: 但大多数人并没有这样做。

sentences.en: The contamination rates have been pretty high.
sentences.zh: 污染率一直相当高。

sentences.en: And they've risen in the past 10 years or so.
sentences.zh: 并且在过去十年左右有所上升。

sentences.en: As a result, a lot of the stuff we were throwing into the recycling bin was never truly recyclable
sentences.zh: 结果就是，我们扔进回收箱的很多东西从一开始就根本不是真正的可回收

sentences.en: material in the first place.
sentences.zh: 材料。

sentences.en: It was just trash.
sentences.zh: 它们只是垃圾。

sentences.en: And a lot of time, it just ended up in landfill
sentences.zh: 很多时候，它们最终只是进了垃圾填埋场

sentences.en: or incineration.
sentences.zh: 或被焚烧。

sentences.en: Operation National Sword didn't create these probleMs. It just revealed them.
sentences.zh: “国剑”行动并没有创造这些问题，它只是揭露了这些问题。

sentences.en: And then threw them back at us.
sentences.zh: 然后又把它们甩回给我们。

sentences.en: Well, mostly threw them at the MRFs.
sentences.zh: 好吧，主要是甩给了材料回收设施（MRF）。

sentences.en: They're the ones with the heaps
sentences.zh: 它们才是堆着

sentences.en: and heaps of useless recycling piling up and wondering where to put it.
sentences.zh: 堆积如山且无用的回收垃圾、正发愁该把它们放哪里的那些机构。

sentences.en: It's been a minute since we spoke laSt. I think things have happened.
sentences.zh: 我们上次谈话已经过去一会儿了。我想发生了很多事。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So I checked back in with Robert Reed, the representative of San Francisco Recology,
sentences.zh: 所以我回访了旧金山回收公司（San Francisco Recology）的代表罗伯特·里德（Robert Reed），

sentences.en: who showed me around their plant back in the good old days of 2016.
sentences.zh: 早在2016年的美好旧时光里，他曾带我参观过他们的工厂。

sentences.en: What's been going on since I saw you last?
sentences.zh: 自从我上次见到你以来，都发生什么了？

sentences.en: Lots of things.
sentences.zh: 很多事情。

sentences.en: If you lose your biggest customer, it really upsets the apple cart.
sentences.zh: 如果你失去了最大的客户，那可真是把事情全搞砸了。

sentences.en: Reed explained that now, in this new buyer's market,
sentences.zh: 里德解释说，现在在这个新的买方市场中，

sentences.en: mills are only accepting the most easily recyclable items,
sentences.zh: 造纸厂只接受最容易回收的物品，

sentences.en: which means the items that are almost perfectly pure and clean.
sentences.zh: 这意味着几乎完全纯净和干净的物品。

sentences.en: There's efforts underway to reduce liquids and any food scraps in recycling bins.
sentences.zh: 目前正在采取措施减少回收箱中的液体和任何食物残渣。

sentences.en: And so Recology has been investing more and more in sorting and cleaning technology
sentences.zh: 因此，Recology一直在加大对分拣和清洁技术的投资，

sentences.en: to make sure they can keep selling, which means they bought more optical sorters.
sentences.zh: 以确保他们能够继续销售，这意味着他们购买了更多的光学分拣机。

sentences.en: As we speak, we're installing state-of-the-art optical sorters in our plant that came from France.
sentences.zh: 就在我们说话的时候，我们正在工厂里安装从法国进口的先进光学分拣机。

sentences.en: They now have seven high-speed computer-controlled optical sorters.
sentences.zh: 他们现在拥有七台高速计算机控制的光学分拣机。

sentences.en: These big, elaborate machines that do the work that we don't want to do.
sentences.zh: 这些大型、复杂的机器替我们做了我们不想做的工作。

sentences.en: But also, the MRFs want us, the consumers, to send them cleaner recycling,
sentences.zh: 而且，材料回收设施希望我们这些消费者送去更干净的回收物，

sentences.en: which would make recycling less expensive and more efficient for everyone.
sentences.zh: 这会让每个人的回收工作成本更低、效率更高。

sentences.en: We're doing things to encourage the public to help us make cleaner bales of recycling.
sentences.zh: 我们正在采取行动鼓励公众帮助我们做出更干净的回收打包料。

sentences.en: And so we launched a new initiative in October called Better at the Bin.
sentences.zh: 因此我们在10月发起了一项名为“回收箱做得更好”（Better at the Bin）的新倡议。

sentences.en: The key to success is all of us doing a better job at sorting our recyclables.
sentences.zh: 成功的关键在于我们所有人都要在分类可回收物时做得更好。

sentences.en: We call this initiative Better at the Bin.
sentences.zh: 我们将这项倡议称为“回收箱做得更好”。

sentences.en: Recology is posting these high-production-value videos on their social media
sentences.zh: Recology正在其社交媒体上

sentences.en: and on betteratthebin.com to try to convince everyone to take these little steps to be better recyclers.
sentences.zh: 以及betteratthebin.com网站上发布这些高制作水准的视频，试图说服每个人采取这些小步骤，成为更好的回收者。

sentences.en: If one half-filled bottle or can gets tossed in the recycling bin, the liquid can ruin the whole lot.
sentences.zh: 如果有一个半满的瓶子或罐子被扔进回收箱，液体就会毁掉整批东西。

sentences.en: Remember Reduce, Reuse, Recycle?
sentences.zh: 还记得减量、重复使用、回收吗？

sentences.en: Well, somewhere along the way, we totally lost track of Reduce and Reuse and focused too much on recycle.
sentences.zh: 嗯，不知在哪个环节，我们完全忘记了减量和重复使用，而把过多精力放在了回收上。

sentences.en: Refuse single-use plastics.
sentences.zh: 拒绝一次性塑料。

sentences.en: Plastic straws, plastic bags, and plastic coffee cup lids.
sentences.zh: 塑料吸管、塑料袋和塑料咖啡杯盖。

sentences.en: Don't buy plastic water bottles.
sentences.zh: 不要买塑料水瓶。

sentences.en: Carry a metal water bottle.
sentences.zh: 随身携带金属水瓶。

sentences.en: Yes, this is 100% true.
sentences.zh: 是的，这百分之百是真的。

sentences.en: We definitely have got to get better about generating less waste and cleaning what we do recycle.
sentences.zh: 我们绝对必须在减少垃圾产生以及清洗我们回收的东西方面做得更好。

sentences.en: But this alone is simplifying the real complexity of the problem.
sentences.zh: 但这单单只是把问题的真正复杂性给简单化了。

sentences.en: For example, at the end of the interview, Robert Reed pulled out a totally normal-looking tube of toothpaste.
sentences.zh: 例如，在采访结束时，罗伯特·里德掏出了一支看起来完全正常的牙膏管。

sentences.en: You can't recycle this container.
sentences.zh: 你无法回收这个容器。

sentences.en: You still have the metal on the inside, the soft plastic on the outside, the hard plastic neck and cap,
sentences.zh: 里面有金属，外面有软塑料，还有硬塑料的瓶颈和盖子，

sentences.en: and your residual toothpaste on the inside, not to mention the printing.
sentences.zh: 里面还有残留的牙膏，更不用说上面的印刷了。

sentences.en: There's four or five materials here, and they all go to landfills or incinerators.
sentences.zh: 这里有四五种材料，它们最终都会去到垃圾填埋场或焚烧炉。

sentences.en: And then he pulled out this small aluminum case.
sentences.zh: 然后他掏出了这个小铝盒。

sentences.en: And I'm opening it up, and inside there's a cake of toothpaste.
sentences.zh: 我把它打开，里面有一块牙膏饼。

sentences.en: It's a dry cake.
sentences.zh: 这是一块干的牙膏饼。

sentences.en: And it lasts for 45 days.
sentences.zh: 它可以用45天。

sentences.en: And at the end of those 45 days, you just drop another cake into the aluminum jar.
sentences.zh: 在那45天结束时，你只需把另一块牙膏饼放入铝罐中。

sentences.en: I mean, can you buy them in the States?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你在美国能买到它们吗？

sentences.en: I haven't been able to find them in the States yet.
sentences.zh: 我目前还无法在美国找到它们。

sentences.en: This one was purchased in France.
sentences.zh: 这个是在法国买的。

sentences.en: This struck me as fairly ridiculous.
sentences.zh: 这让我觉得相当荒谬。

sentences.en: How are we supposed to buy cakes of toothpaste from France that we don't know exist?
sentences.zh: 我们怎么能去买那些我们都不知道其存在的来自法国的牙膏饼呢？

sentences.en: And it's not like shipping toothpaste across the Atlantic is exactly environmentally friendly.
sentences.zh: 而且把牙膏运过大西洋也算不上多么环保。

sentences.en: Again, absolutely true.
sentences.zh: 再说一次，绝对如此。

sentences.en: We need to get better at using less and cleaning our recycling and researching what our local systems will accept.
sentences.zh: 我们需要更好地做到少用、清洗可回收物，并了解我们当地的系统接受什么。

sentences.en: Definitely.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: But, like, we throw out a lot of junk because we are sold a lot of junk.
sentences.zh: 但是，我们扔掉了很多垃圾，是因为我们被兜售了大量垃圾。

sentences.en: So much of this problem is about the products we are sold and have access to.
sentences.zh: 这个问题的很大一部分在于我们被推销和能够接触到的产品。

sentences.en: I'm just getting fed up with the way that we talk about our pollution problem.
sentences.zh: 我真是受够了我们讨论污染问题的方式。

sentences.en: Matt Wilkins is a biologist, and he wrote a piece for Scientific American about our current recycling mess.
sentences.zh: 马特·威尔金斯（Matt Wilkins）是一位生物学家，他为《科学美国人》写了一篇关于我们当前回收困境的文章。

sentences.en: We should not have to fight as individuals against this constant onslaught of plastic.
sentences.zh: 我们不应该作为个人去对抗这种源源不断的塑料冲击。

sentences.en: Take, for example, the term litter bug.
sentences.zh: 以“乱扔垃圾者”（litter bug）这个词为例。

sentences.en: You don't want to be a litter bug, right?
sentences.zh: 你不想当一个乱扔垃圾的人，对吧？

sentences.en: You know, litter bugs are the problem.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，乱扔垃圾的人才是问题所在。

sentences.en: It's not the fact that we have this unfettered production of billions of containers happening at all times
sentences.zh: 问题并不在于我们一直在无节制地生产数十亿个容器

sentences.en: and no infrastructure to reclaim those materials.
sentences.zh: 却没有相应的回收这些材料的基础设施。

sentences.en: And that nickname, litter bug, it was popularized in large part by a group called Keep America Beautiful.
sentences.zh: 而“乱扔垃圾的人”这个绰号，很大程度上是由一个名为“保持美国美丽”的组织推广开来的。

sentences.en: This lobbying group, Keep America Beautiful, founded by, you know, Pepsi and Coke and Philip Morris, among others.
sentences.zh: 这个名为“保持美国美丽”的游说团体，是由百事可乐、可口可乐和菲利普莫里斯等公司创立的。

sentences.en: Keep America Beautiful was formed in 1953.
sentences.zh: “保持美国美丽”组织成立于1953年。

sentences.en: Around the same time, Vermont was creating legislation way ahead of its time.
sentences.zh: 大约在同一时期，佛蒙特州正在制定一项极具前瞻性的立法。

sentences.en: It would have made it illegal to bottle anything in a non-refillable container.
sentences.zh: 该法案本将规定，用不可回收的容器装瓶属于违法行为。

sentences.en: And, of course, the beverage industry was against it.
sentences.zh: 当然，饮料行业对此表示反对。

sentences.en: They wanted to frame the problem of waste as something that should be dealt with not by companies, but by consumers.
sentences.zh: 他们希望将垃圾问题包装成一个不应由公司解决、而应由消费者承担的问题。

sentences.en: You know, litter bugs.
sentences.zh: 也就是，乱扔垃圾的人。

sentences.en: Keep America Beautiful was essentially a lobbying group.
sentences.zh: “保持美国美丽”本质上就是一个游说团体。

sentences.en: But its masterstroke in consumer shaming came in 1971,
sentences.zh: 但他们在羞辱消费者方面的神来之笔发生在1971年，

sentences.en: when they rolled out a very persuasive advertising campaign.
sentences.zh: 当时他们推出了一则极具说服力的广告活动。

sentences.en: Yeah, the crying Indian ad was, basically, there's a Native American canoeing through, like, a pristine forest,
sentences.zh: 对，那个流泪的印第安人广告，基本上讲的是一个美洲原住民划着独木舟穿过一片原始森林，

sentences.en: which is apparently right next to a highway.
sentences.zh: 而这片森林显然紧挨着一条高速公路。

sentences.en: And he paddles right up to the bank of the highway and climbs out,
sentences.zh: 他一直划到高速公路的岸边并爬了上去，

sentences.en: and then people are speeding by, and then a motorist, like, basically hits him with a bag of trash.
sentences.zh: 周围的车呼啸而过，然后有个司机，基本上是用一袋垃圾砸了他一下。

sentences.en: And then the camera pans up, and there's a tear rolling down his cheek.
sentences.zh: 接着镜头摇上，一滴眼泪顺着他的脸颊流了下来。

sentences.en: This ad, which, ahem, featured an Italian actor playing a Native American, became iconic.
sentences.zh: 这则广告——咳，由一名意大利演员扮演美洲原住民——成了一个标志性的符号。

sentences.en: But its basic lesson wasn't exactly wrong.
sentences.zh: 但它的基本道理并不是完全错误的。

sentences.en: But the ad made it seem that so long as consumers stopped littering,
sentences.zh: 然而这则广告让人觉得，只要消费者不再乱扔垃圾，

sentences.en: all of our garbage woes would be solved.
sentences.zh: 我们所有的垃圾困境就能迎刃而解。

sentences.en: Which, of course, is not true.
sentences.zh: 当然，这并不是事实。

sentences.en: It let the corporations that were making all those disposable items off the hook.
sentences.zh: 它让那些制造所有这些一次性用品的大公司逃脱了责任。

sentences.en: Although, to be fair, this is not exactly their stance anymore.
sentences.zh: 虽然平心而论，这已经完全不是他们现在的立场了。

sentences.en: Only a few years after the crying Indian ad, Keep America Beautiful, changed their tune.
sentences.zh: 就在流泪的印第安人广告播出几年后，“保持美国美丽”就改变了调门。

sentences.en: So they actively fought this legislation in a public way, I think up until the early 80s.
sentences.zh: 因此，我认为他们在公开场合积极反对这项立法，一直持续到80年代初。

sentences.en: And then they kind of switched tactics and have basically, since then,
sentences.zh: 然后他们改变了策略，基本上从那时起，

sentences.en: just been kind of getting in on the Earth Day push and, you know,
sentences.zh: 就只是顺应地球日的浪潮，然后，你知道的，

sentences.en: telling people to recycle and organizing cleanups and stuff.
sentences.zh: 告诉人们要回收利用，组织清理活动之类的事情。

sentences.en: Representatives from Keep America Beautiful told me that they now advocate recycling legislation
sentences.zh: “保持美国美丽”的代表告诉我说，他们现在支持回收立法，

sentences.en: and that their corporate partners want to do their part.
sentences.zh: 并且他们的企业伙伴也希望尽自己的一份力。

sentences.en: These days, especially in the shadow of National Sword,
sentences.zh: 如今，特别是伴随着“国剑”行动的阴影，

sentences.en: corporations and governments have had to acknowledge the scale of our recycling problem
sentences.zh: 企业和政府不得不以非常公开的方式承认

sentences.en: in a very public way.
sentences.zh: 我们回收问题的严重性。

sentences.en: We are gathered here today to advance solutions to today's recycling challenges.
sentences.zh: 我们今天齐聚一堂，是为了推进解决当今回收挑战的方案。

sentences.en: That's the voice of Andrew Wheeler,
sentences.zh: 这是安德鲁·惠勒的声音，

sentences.en: former coal industry lobbyist and current acting administrator of the Environmental Protection Agency.
sentences.zh: 他曾是煤炭行业的说客，现任环境保护局的代理局长。

sentences.en: In November of 2018, the EPA convened a two-hour-long panel discussion
sentences.zh: 2018年11月，环保局召开了长达两小时的小组讨论会，

sentences.en: in an attempt to attempt to deal with the fallout from National Sword.
sentences.zh: 试图应对“国剑”行动带来的余波。

sentences.en: We cannot tackle these challenges alone,
sentences.zh: 我们无法单枪匹马应对这些挑战，

sentences.en: which is why we are thrilled to have representatives from nearly every aspect
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么我们很高兴能请到来自材料经济各个领域的代表

sentences.en: of the materials economy gathered here today.
sentences.zh: 今天齐聚一堂。

sentences.en: At this literal roundtable were all the biggest names in the recycling world,
sentences.zh: 在这个名副其实的圆桌会议上，汇聚了回收界所有最大牌的名字，

sentences.en: from waste management to Walmart.
sentences.zh: 从废物管理公司到沃尔玛。

sentences.en: It's not every day that you get Keurig and Starbucks and Coca-Cola, Pepsi and Dr. Pepper
sentences.zh: Keurig、星巴克、可口可乐、百事可乐和Dr. Pepper聚在同一个房间里可不常见，

sentences.en: all in the same room together, and I'm really glad you're all here.
sentences.zh: 我真的很高兴大家能齐聚一堂。

sentences.en: Keep America Beautiful was there,
sentences.zh: “保持美国美丽”也出席了，

sentences.en: and Cole Rosengren was also there in the room,
sentences.zh: 科尔·罗森格伦也在现场，

sentences.en: covering it for Waste Dive.
sentences.zh: 他代表《Waste Dive》进行报道。

sentences.en: Maybe the CPA summit will lead to something.
sentences.zh: 也许环保局峰会能带来一些改变。

sentences.en: I'd hate to be so flippant about that.
sentences.zh: 我可不想对此表现得太轻率。

sentences.en: I mean, maybe it does.
sentences.zh: 我是说，也许真的会有用。

sentences.en: That'd be cool.
sentences.zh: 那可就太酷了。

sentences.en: Basically, each representative had like less than one minute to speak,
sentences.zh: 基本上，每位代表只有不到一分钟的发言时间，

sentences.en: and everyone mentioned a million different problems with our recycling system.
sentences.zh: 每个人都提到了我们回收系统中成百上千的不同问题。

sentences.en: But, there was this butterfly at the bottom of Pandora's box.
sentences.zh: 但是，潘多拉魔盒的底部还藏着这样一只蝴蝶。

sentences.en: This common refrain that companies, recyclers, and municipalities alike all mentioned.
sentences.zh: 这是公司、回收商和市政当局共同提到的一个共同副歌。

sentences.en: Consumers look for us to give them sustainable products.
sentences.zh: 消费者希望我们能提供可持续的产品。

sentences.en: We need to think about what is the future of packaging.
sentences.zh: 我们需要思考包装的未来是什么。

sentences.en: And we have to design the right way.
sentences.zh: 我们必须进行正确的设计。

sentences.en: Yes, dear listener, one of the most important solutions to our recycling woes
sentences.zh: 是的，亲爱的听众，我们解决回收困境最重要的方案之一，

sentences.en: might actually lay in design.
sentences.zh: 可能就藏在设计之中。

sentences.en: At the EPA meeting, the representative from Procter & Gamble talked about
sentences.zh: 在环保局的会议上，宝洁公司的代表谈到了

sentences.en: their award-winning container made out of plastic cleaned up from the beach.
sentences.zh: 他们用从海滩清理出的塑料制成的获奖容器。

sentences.en: What we did with a head-and-shoulders bottle was we took the iconic white bottle,
sentences.zh: 我们对海飞丝瓶子所做的是，保留了标志性的白色瓶子，

sentences.en: we used plastic collected from beaches, and it became gray.
sentences.zh: 我们使用了从海滩收集的塑料，它变成了灰色。

sentences.en: But we sold it that way, and consumers bought it.
sentences.zh: 但我们就是这样把它卖出去了，消费者也买账了。

sentences.en: Okay, so this was a limited-edition product.
sentences.zh: 好吧，所以这是一个限量版产品。

sentences.en: And, I kid you not, it was only available in France.
sentences.zh: 而且，我没开玩笑，它只在法国出售。

sentences.en: Damn it, France!
sentences.zh: 见鬼，法国！

sentences.en: But, the point is, that kind of packaging is possible.
sentences.zh: 但是，关键在于，这种包装是可行的。

sentences.en: These companies have the capacity and the technology.
sentences.zh: 这些公司有能力也有技术。

sentences.en: And we can ask for it.
sentences.zh: 我们可以提出这样的要求。

sentences.en: I think another thing that we can do is demand better design of everything
sentences.zh: 我认为我们可以做的另一件事，就是要求对所有产品进行更好的设计，

sentences.en: with the end-of-life planned from the beginning.
sentences.zh: 从一开始就规划好其生命周期的终点。

sentences.en: Matt Wilkins, the biologist again.
sentences.zh: 马特·威尔金斯，这位生物学家又说话了。

sentences.en: And better design can mean a couple of things.
sentences.zh: 更好的设计可以意味着好几件事。

sentences.en: Yes, it can mean finding new ways to use recycled materials,
sentences.zh: 是的，它可以意味着寻找使用回收材料的新方法，

sentences.en: like that gray head-and-shoulders bottle.
sentences.zh: 就像那个灰色的海飞丝瓶子一样。

sentences.en: Or, at the very least, it can be making products really easy and efficient to recycle.
sentences.zh: 或者，至少，它可以让产品变得非常易于且高效地回收。

sentences.en: Everything should be able to break down into its composite materials
sentences.zh: 一切都应该能够分解为其复合材料，

sentences.en: and separate them in a way that doesn't introduce impurities,
sentences.zh: 并以不会引入杂质的方式将其分离，

sentences.en: so they can be used again.
sentences.zh: 这样它们就可以再次被使用。

sentences.en: And designers can and should visit Murphs and Mills.
sentences.zh: 设计师可以而且应该去参观回收分拣中心和加工厂。

sentences.en: They should know how their products and packaging sort or don't sort.
sentences.zh: 他们应该了解他们的产品和包装是否能够被分拣。

sentences.en: Whether they break down or don't break down.
sentences.zh: 它们是否能够降解。

sentences.en: Designers can also use biodegradable materials,
sentences.zh: 设计师还可以使用生物降解材料，

sentences.en: or materials like aluminum that recycle more easily than plastic.
sentences.zh: 或者像铝这样比塑料更容易回收的材料。

sentences.en: But the ideal thing is to design products,
sentences.zh: 但最理想的做法是设计出这样的产品，

sentences.en: or even parts of products,
sentences.zh: 甚至是产品的某些部件，

sentences.en: that don't need to be thrown away at all.
sentences.zh: 它们根本不需要被扔掉。

sentences.en: It's down to product design,
sentences.zh: 这归结于产品设计，

sentences.en: and that you design things that can be repaired.
sentences.zh: 你要设计出能够被维修的东西。

sentences.en: Like those toothbrushes with detachable hands and stuff?
sentences.zh: 就像那些带有可拆卸手柄的牙刷之类的东西？

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Oh.
sentences.zh: 哦。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: And cell phones that you can swap components in and out of.
sentences.zh: 还有那些可以拆卸和更换组件的手机。

sentences.en: The Berkeley professor, Kate O'Neill, says,
sentences.zh: 加州大学伯克利分校教授凯特·奥尼尔说，

sentences.en: yes, companies have to design greener products.
sentences.zh: 是的，公司必须设计更环保的产品。

sentences.en: But then the next step is that these shouldn't just be specialty iteMs.
sentences.zh: 但接下来的步骤是，这些不应该只是特色商品。

sentences.en: That should be the norm.
sentences.zh: 那应该成为常态。

sentences.en: I guess people have the label on it,
sentences.zh: 我想人们会在上面贴上标签，

sentences.en: so people who are environmentally conscious will buy it.
sentences.zh: 所以有环保意识的人会买它。

sentences.en: But it turns out it might mean that people who don't care won't buy it.
sentences.zh: 但事实证明，这可能意味着不在乎的人就不会买它。

sentences.en: Well, so it seems like this kind of paradox where we're saying,
sentences.zh: 所以，这似乎是一种悖论，一方面我们说，

sentences.en: like, you know, don't blame the consumer.
sentences.zh: 比如，你知道的，不要责怪消费者。

sentences.en: There's a whole world of influences.
sentences.zh: 这里面有整个世界的影响力。

sentences.en: But also, like, it's up to us to harness the power of capitalism
sentences.zh: 但另一方面，比如，我们要利用资本主义的力量，

sentences.en: and, you know, bend the market to our will as people who spend money.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，作为花钱的人，把市场扭转成我们想要的样子。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Which also seems like it's putting the onus kind of back on the consumer now.
sentences.zh: 这似乎又把责任推回给了消费者。

sentences.en: Well, sometimes I also think it's not just consumers,
sentences.zh: 嗯，有时我也认为这不仅仅是消费者的问题，

sentences.en: but how we act as citizens.
sentences.zh: 而是我们作为公民如何行事的问题。

sentences.en: So listen.
sentences.zh: 所以听着。

sentences.en: In the course of researching this story, I've had various freakouts.
sentences.zh: 在研究这个故事的过程中，我经历过各种抓狂。

sentences.en: At one point, I was defiantly tossing my aluminum cans in the trash,
sentences.zh: 有一次，我一气之下把铝罐扔进了垃圾桶，

sentences.en: like, wake up, sheeple, recycling isn't real!
sentences.zh: 心想，醒醒吧，清醒点，回收根本不是真的！

sentences.en: But that's not quite true.
sentences.zh: 但事实并非完全如此。

sentences.en: Like, don't do what I did.
sentences.zh: 所以，别学我这样。

sentences.en: Instead, ask around and find out what is happening to the recycling where you live.
sentences.zh: 相反，去打听一下，弄清楚你住的地方的回收到底是怎么运作的。

sentences.en: This is a system that has been kept deliberately invisible
sentences.zh: 为了我们的便利，

sentences.en: for the sake of our convenience.
sentences.zh: 这个系统被故意隐藏了起来。

sentences.en: And we need to learn how to notice it
sentences.zh: 我们需要学会去注意到它，

sentences.en: and really think about how our stuff is made
sentences.zh: 并真正思考我们的东西是如何制造的，

sentences.en: and where it's going
sentences.zh: 以及当我们把它扔掉时

sentences.en: when we throw it away.
sentences.zh: 它去了哪里。

sentences.en: Operation National Sword could be a wake-up call.
sentences.zh: “国剑”行动可能是一个警钟。

sentences.en: But only if everyone can hear it.
sentences.zh: 但前提是每个人都能听到它。

sentences.en: Okay, you might be skeptical that design can really make a difference in recycling.
sentences.zh: 好了，你可能会怀疑设计是否真的能在回收方面带来改变。

sentences.en: But I assure you, it can.
sentences.zh: 但我向你保证，它可以。

sentences.en: Not just product design, but systems design.
sentences.zh: 不仅仅是产品设计，还有系统设计。

sentences.en: Take, for example, Taipei, the capital of Taiwan.
sentences.zh: 以台湾的首都台北为例。

sentences.en: They became one of the cleanest cities in the world in only a few years
sentences.zh: 他们通过使用会唱歌的垃圾车，

sentences.en: by using singing garbage trucks.
sentences.zh: 在短短几年内成为了世界上最干净的城市之一。

sentences.en: That full story.
sentences.zh: 完整的内幕。

sentences.en: After this.
sentences.zh: 广告之后继续。

sentences.en: At the top of the show, I referenced an episode that Avery reported back in 2016.
sentences.zh: 节目一开始，我提到了埃弗里在2016年做的一期报道。

sentences.en: We called it Separation Anxiety.
sentences.zh: 我们把它叫做《分离焦虑》。

sentences.en: People really loved it.
sentences.zh: 大家非常喜欢它。

sentences.en: So if you missed it back then, here it is now.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你当时错过了，现在就听听看吧。

sentences.en: Enjoy.
sentences.zh: 请欣赏。

sentences.en: If you can recognize any piece of classical music,
sentences.zh: 如果你能认出任何一首古典音乐，

sentences.en: I bet it's this one.
sentences.zh: 我敢说一定是这首。

sentences.en: This is Fur Elise, written by Ludwig van Beethoven in 1810.
sentences.zh: 这是路德维希·范·贝多芬于1810年创作的《致爱丽丝》。

sentences.en: Maybe it reminds you of piano lessons you took when you were a kid.
sentences.zh: 也许它会让你想起你小时候上的钢琴课。

sentences.en: In my town, it was also the song the ice cream truck used to play.
sentences.zh: 在我住的小镇上，这也是冰淇淋车播放的曲子。

sentences.en: That's producer Avery Truffleman.
sentences.zh: 这是制作人埃弗里·特拉夫曼。

sentences.en: But if you live in Taiwan, and you hear a truck rumbling down the street playing Fur Elise,
sentences.zh: 但如果你住在台湾，听到一辆卡车轰鸣着驶过街道，播放着《致爱丽丝》，

sentences.en: it doesn't mean it's time to buy a popsicle.
sentences.zh: 这并不意味着该买冰棒了。

sentences.en: It means it's time to take out your trash.
sentences.zh: 这意味着该去倒垃圾了。

sentences.en: Because this is what a garbage truck in Taiwan sounds like.
sentences.zh: 因为这就是台湾垃圾车的声音。

sentences.en: This garbage truck song isn't just supposed to be cute and fun.
sentences.zh: 这个垃圾车之歌可不只是为了可爱和好玩。

sentences.en: Although it is also supposed to be cute and fun.
sentences.zh: 虽然它其实也挺可爱好玩的。

sentences.en: The singing garbage trucks are all a part of a completely different way of thinking about waste disposal.
sentences.zh: 这些会唱歌的垃圾车其实代表了一种完全不同的废物处理思维。

sentences.en: Completely different, that is, from the way that we think about it in the United States.
sentences.zh: 也就是说，这和我们在美国看待垃圾的方式完全不同。

sentences.en: In the late 1990s, Taiwan recycled only 5% of its waste.
sentences.zh: 在20世纪90年代末，台湾的垃圾回收率只有5%。

sentences.en: Today, Taiwan recycles well over half.
sentences.zh: 如今，台湾的垃圾回收率远超一半。

sentences.en: The country is now among the world's top recyclers.
sentences.zh: 这个国家如今跻身世界顶级回收国之列。

sentences.en: And what changed in this period has a lot to do with the way that the trash is collected.
sentences.zh: 而在此期间发生的变化，很大程度上与垃圾收集的方式有关。

sentences.en: Okay, Fur Elise isn't the only song the trucks play.
sentences.zh: 好吧，《致爱丽丝》并不是垃圾车播放的唯一歌曲。

sentences.en: In Taipei, the capital of Taiwan, the trucks also play this song.
sentences.zh: 在台湾首都台北，垃圾车还会播放这首歌。

sentences.en: That's A Maiden's Prayer, by Polish composer Tekla Baraszewska-Baranowska.
sentences.zh: 那是波兰作曲家泰克拉·巴拉谢夫斯卡-巴拉诺夫斯卡创作的《少女的祈祷》。

sentences.en: And in Taipei City, the garbage trucks just alternate between these two songs.
sentences.zh: 在台北市，垃圾车就在这两首歌之间交替播放。

sentences.en: They take turns to play these two songs, two music, in Taipei City.
sentences.zh: 它们在台北市轮流播放这两首曲子，两首音乐。

sentences.en: Even the elementary school kids can sing the song.
sentences.zh: 连小学的孩子们都会唱这首歌。

sentences.en: So, we are brainwashed.
sentences.zh: 所以，我们都被洗脑了。

sentences.en: This is Dr. Jasmine Wong, and she grew up in Taipei.
sentences.zh: 这是黄asmine博士，她在台北长大。

sentences.en: Since I was a child, I knew that every time when the garbage truck comes, we will hear da-da-da-da-da-da-da-da.
sentences.zh: 从小我就知道，每当垃圾车来的时候，我们就会听到哒哒哒哒哒哒哒哒。

sentences.en: Now, the singing garbage trucks are such a part of life, it's hard to imagine a time before them.
sentences.zh: 现在，唱歌的垃圾车已经成了生活的一部分，很难想象没有它们的日子。

sentences.en: But that time actually wasn't too long ago.
sentences.zh: 但那段日子其实并不算太久远。

sentences.en: We used to have a lot of big dumpsters.
sentences.zh: 我们过去有很多大型垃圾箱。

sentences.en: So, there were a lot of rats, mosquitoes, and things like that.
sentences.zh: 所以，那里有很多老鼠、蚊子之类的东西。

sentences.en: And it's not good for our health.
sentences.zh: 而且这对我们的健康不利。

sentences.en: Just a couple of decades ago, Taipei residents threw their trash into massive, smelly dumpsters on the streets.
sentences.zh: 就在几十年前，台北居民把垃圾扔在街上巨大而恶臭的垃圾箱里。

sentences.en: Garbage would end up in piles on the sidewalk and in parks.
sentences.zh: 垃圾最后会堆在人行道上和公园里。

sentences.en: It would fester in the heat.
sentences.zh: 它们会在炎热中腐烂。

sentences.en: It was just nasty.
sentences.zh: 那简直太糟糕了。

sentences.en: Then, Taiwan's democratization accelerated in the mid-1980s and created this desire to tidy up.
sentences.zh: 然后，在20世纪80年代中期，台湾的民主化进程加速，并催生了一种打扫干净的愿望。

sentences.en: Being a modern country means being a clean country.
sentences.zh: 作为一个现代国家意味着要成为一个干净的国家。

sentences.en: And when you have foreign visitors coming and visiting your capital, they shouldn't think, oh, this place is dirty.
sentences.zh: 当有外国游客来参观你们的首都时，他们不应该觉得，哦，这个地方真脏。

sentences.en: This is Mary Alice Haddad, chair of East Asian Studies at Wesleyan University.
sentences.zh: 这是卫斯理大学东亚研究系主任玛丽·爱丽丝·哈达德。

sentences.en: In Taiwan, the pro-democracy movement got fully entangled with the environmental movement.
sentences.zh: 在台湾，民主运动与环保运动完全交织在了一起。

sentences.en: And so, as all those things moved together in the late 80s, early 90s,
sentences.zh: 因此，随着所有这些事情在80年代末、90年代初共同推进，

sentences.en: then the pro-democracy and pro-environment agendas got onto the public consciousness.
sentences.zh: 民主和环保的议程便进入了公众的意识中。

sentences.en: Also, the environmental movement had a practical end.
sentences.zh: 此外，环保运动还有一个现实的目的。

sentences.en: Taiwan was running out of space to actually put piles of trash because it's a small island, an extremely populous small island.
sentences.zh: 台湾快没有地方堆放垃圾了，因为它是一个小岛，一个人口极其稠密的小岛。

sentences.en: There's not that much space where you're going to stick all your junk.
sentences.zh: 没有那么多空间让你塞进所有的垃圾。

sentences.en: Whereas, in the United States, there has been historically a sense of the untamed, untapped, endless wilderness.
sentences.zh: 而在美国，历史上一直有一种未被征服、未被开发、无尽荒野的感觉。

sentences.en: And you could just throw your junk into the wilderness and it would go away and you wouldn't have to worry about it anymore.
sentences.zh: 你可以把垃圾直接扔进荒野，它就会消失，你再也不用为此担心了。

sentences.en: Not true in Taipei.
sentences.zh: 在台北可不是这样。

sentences.en: It's a big city, but it's really clean and the subways are clean and the stores are clean and the sidewalks are clean and it's really pleasant to be there.
sentences.zh: 这是一座大城市，但它真的很干净，地铁很干净，商店很干净，人行道也很干净，待在那里真的很舒服。

sentences.en: You'd never know that the city used to have piles of garbage littering the streets.
sentences.zh: 你绝不会知道这座城市过去曾有成堆的垃圾散落在街头。

sentences.en: Taipei and a number of other Taiwanese cities reduced the amount of trash by changing the way the trash got collected.
sentences.zh: 台北和台湾的其他许多城市通过改变垃圾收集方式减少了垃圾量。

sentences.en: Take a look at my garbage.
sentences.zh: 看看我的垃圾。

sentences.en: This is my friend Erin Newport.
sentences.zh: 这是我的朋友艾琳·纽波特。

sentences.en: She lives in Taipei, where the garbage truck comes five nights a week.
sentences.zh: 她住在台北，那里的垃圾车一周来五个晚上。

sentences.en: Evenings, like after work.
sentences.zh: 傍晚，比如下班后。

sentences.en: It comes Monday, Tuesday, Thursday, Friday, and Saturday.
sentences.zh: 它在周一、周二、周四、周五和周六来。

sentences.en: In Erin's neighborhood, trucks come twice in the evening, at five and at seven.
sentences.zh: 在艾琳的社区，垃圾车晚上来两次，分别在五点和七点。

sentences.en: Normally you take out the trash like once a week on one of the days.
sentences.zh: 通常你一周左右倒一次垃圾，挑其中一天。

sentences.en: Ah, yeah, usually once.
sentences.zh: 啊，对，通常是一次。

sentences.en: I mean, it's kind of hard sometimes to find the time to always be home at five, five or seven.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，有时候很难找到时间总是在五点、五点或七点呆在家里。

sentences.en: Erin has to gather her own garbage and recycling and bring it out to a designated street corner and wait for the big yellow truck to come with an ear perked for the sound of your release or maiden's prayer coming down the block.
sentences.zh: 艾琳必须收集自己的垃圾和可回收物，把它们拿到指定的街角，等待那辆黄色的卡车到来，同时竖起耳朵倾听街区里传来的《致爱丽丝》或《少女的祈祷》的声音。

sentences.en: Basically, this is a binless system or a garbage canless system.
sentences.zh: 基本上，这是一个没有固定垃圾桶的系统，或者说是一个无垃圾桶系统。

sentences.en: Your trash goes right from your house to the truck, ideally without ever touching the street.
sentences.zh: 你的垃圾直接从家里运到卡车上，理想情况下根本不会接触街道。

sentences.en: You just have to bring out your garbage in a special bag.
sentences.zh: 你只需要用一个特殊的袋子把垃圾拿出来。

sentences.en: I pay my garbage bill by purchasing these blue Taipei City garbage bags.
sentences.zh: 我通过购买这些蓝色的台北市垃圾袋来支付垃圾费。

sentences.en: These official blue garbage bags say City of Taipei on them, and each is emblazoned with a stamp.
sentences.zh: 这些官方的蓝色垃圾袋上印着“台北市”，每个袋子上都有一个印章。

sentences.en: I buy them from the convenience store across the street.
sentences.zh: 我是从街对面的便利店买的。

sentences.en: The official blue garbage bags come in a number of different sizes, ranging from three liters to 120 liters.
sentences.zh: 官方蓝色垃圾袋有多种不同尺寸，从3升到120升不等。

sentences.en: So the more garbage you throw away, the more it'll cost you.
sentences.zh: 所以你扔的垃圾越多，花费就越多。

sentences.en: And although Taipei residents have to pay for their garbage by the bag, recycling and compost are free.
sentences.zh: 尽管台北居民必须按袋支付垃圾处理费，但回收物和厨余垃圾是免费的。

sentences.en: You don't need to buy bags for them at all.
sentences.zh: 你根本不需要为此买袋子。

sentences.en: You can just take out your recycling in non-official plastic bags, and you can generate as much compost and recycling as you'd like.
sentences.zh: 你可以直接用非官方的塑料袋拿走可回收物，并且可以产生任意多的厨余垃圾和可回收物。

sentences.en: So residents are incentivized to recycle more and throw out less.
sentences.zh: 因此，居民们被激励去回收更多、扔得更少。

sentences.en: I watched Erin sort out all of her recyclables into perfect categories.
sentences.zh: 我看着艾琳把她所有的可回收物分类成完美的类别。

sentences.en: These are the cans.
sentences.zh: 这些是罐子。

sentences.en: Cans and bottles.
sentences.zh: 罐子和瓶子。

sentences.en: So we have a few tea bottles.
sentences.zh: 所以我们有几个茶瓶。

sentences.en: So in Taipei, every yellow garbage truck is followed by a small, white recycling truck, which is basically a cart full of different bins.
sentences.zh: 在台北，每辆黄色垃圾车后面都跟着一辆小白回收车，这基本上是一辆装满不同垃圾桶的手推车。

sentences.en: There's a bin for plastic bottles, one for glass bottles, different metals and cans, papers and cardboards,
sentences.zh: 有一个装塑料瓶的垃圾桶，一个装玻璃瓶的，不同的金属和罐子，纸张和纸板，

sentences.en: and a compost bucket for raw food waste, and a compost bucket for cooked food waste.
sentences.zh: 一个装生厨余垃圾的桶，和一个装熟厨余垃圾的桶。

sentences.en: Taipei residents have to sort their recycling into all these different categories themselves.
sentences.zh: 台北居民必须自己将可回收物分类到所有这些不同的类别中。

sentences.en: Although in the white recycling trucks, there are officials and volunteers who can help instruct you about which item goes where.
sentences.zh: 虽然在白色回收车上，有官员和志愿者可以指导你哪些物品该放在哪里。

sentences.en: So Erin, her housemates, and I got all of her bags of trash and different kinds of recycling sorted out.
sentences.zh: 所以艾琳、她的室友和我把她所有的垃圾袋和各种可回收物都分类好了。

sentences.en: And then we walked about a block down the street to wait with the rest of her neighbors,
sentences.zh: 然后我们沿着街道走了大约一个街区，和她的其他邻居一起等待，

sentences.en: who were all clutching official blue garbage bags.
sentences.zh: 他们手里都紧紧抓着官方的蓝色垃圾袋。

sentences.en: Quite a lot of people gathered here today.
sentences.zh: 今天这里聚集了相当多的人。

sentences.en: I'd say this is maybe larger than your average crew.
sentences.zh: 我想这可能比平均人数要多。

sentences.en: And then, the moment we were waiting for,
sentences.zh: 然后，在我们期待的时刻，

sentences.en: there was this mad dash of people swarming to the school bus yellow garbage truck and the white recycling truck.
sentences.zh: 人们疯狂地冲向校车黄色的垃圾车和白色的回收车。

sentences.en: Okay, this one, yeah, people are tossing it in.
sentences.zh: 好吧，这个，对，人们正在把它扔进去。

sentences.en: Swiftly tossing their separate recyclables in the bins,
sentences.zh: 迅速把各自的可回收物扔进垃圾桶，

sentences.en: tossing their blue bags in the garbage truck, and running away.
sentences.zh: 把蓝色袋子扔进垃圾车，然后跑开。

sentences.en: It was madness.
sentences.zh: 这太疯狂了。

sentences.en: Like, extremely well-organized madness.
sentences.zh: 就像是一场极其井然有序的疯狂。

sentences.en: That was so chaotic.
sentences.zh: 那太混乱了。

sentences.en: And this system, for all its chaos, has been working.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此混乱，这个系统一直都在发挥作用。

sentences.en: Taipei City used to produce 3,296 tons of trash a day.
sentences.zh: 台北市过去每天产生3,296吨垃圾。

sentences.en: Today, the city produces about 1,000 tons a day.
sentences.zh: 如今，该市每天产生约1,000吨垃圾。

sentences.en: That is, according to Chen Weichu, one of 65 officials who supervise the garbage trucks and their routes.
sentences.zh: 这是根据负责监督垃圾车及其路线的65名官员之一陈维初（音译）所说。

sentences.en: I met him at a garbage pickup site, where Jasmine Wong acted as interpreter.
sentences.zh: 我在一个垃圾收集点遇到了他，黄asmine担任翻译。

sentences.en: Everybody, this is Mr. Chen.
sentences.zh: 各位，这位是陈先生。

sentences.en: Hi.
sentences.zh: 嗨。

sentences.en: And he is his supervisor.
sentences.zh: 他是他的主管。

sentences.en: Hey.
sentences.zh: 嘿。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: In his district, Chen oversees 20 garbage truck routes.
sentences.zh: 在他的辖区内，陈监督着20条垃圾车路线。

sentences.en: And all those trucks have to make sure that citizens are sorting properly.
sentences.zh: 所有这些卡车都必须确保市民正确分类。

sentences.en: If they find garbage in the recycling bag, the people here will tell them that you cannot do that one more time.
sentences.zh: 如果他们在回收袋里发现垃圾，这里的人会告诉他们不能再这样做了。

sentences.en: Otherwise, you will get ticket.
sentences.zh: 否则，你会收到罚单。

sentences.en: And how much is the ticket?
sentences.zh: 罚单多少钱？

sentences.en: dollars.
sentences.zh: 元。

sentences.en: But that's the maximum.
sentences.zh: 但那是最高金额。

sentences.en: And you might think, this is such a drag.
sentences.zh: 你可能会想，这太麻烦了。

sentences.en: There must be some people who buck the system by tossing their trash into public trash cans.
sentences.zh: 肯定有人把垃圾扔进公共垃圾桶来逃避这个系统。

sentences.en: Well, there are hardly any public trash cans in Taipei.
sentences.zh: 嗯，台北几乎没有什么公共垃圾桶。

sentences.en: They're only in train stations or at bus stops.
sentences.zh: 它们只在火车站或公交车站才有。

sentences.en: And those are little.
sentences.zh: 而且那些都很小。

sentences.en: They come up just below your knees.
sentences.zh: 它们只到你的膝盖以下。

sentences.en: So in Taipei, for the most part, if you eat a candy or buy a coffee, you just take your empty coffee cup or your candy wrapper, put it in your pocket, and bring it home.
sentences.zh: 所以在台北，大多数情况下，如果你吃一颗糖或者买一杯咖啡，你只需把空咖啡杯或糖纸放进口袋，然后带回家。

sentences.en: It's your trash that you put in your blue bag and bring out to the truck yourself.
sentences.zh: 这是你放进蓝色袋子里并亲自带到卡车上的垃圾。

sentences.en: It's hard to imagine a system like this working here in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 很难想象这样的系统能在这里（美国）行得通。

sentences.en: Every city here has a different method of trash pickup.
sentences.zh: 这里的每个城市都有不同的垃圾收集方法。

sentences.en: But across the board, the uniting factor is that our American trash pickup systems strive to be invisible.
sentences.zh: 但总的来说，共同点是我们的美国垃圾收集系统努力做到隐形。

sentences.en: The trucks make great efforts to come when we're working or sleeping or trying to sleep, keeping out of the way of traffic and not disturbing the flow of the city.
sentences.zh: 垃圾车尽最大努力在我们工作、睡觉或试图睡觉的时候来，避开交通，不干扰城市的运行。

sentences.en: We take our trash and our recycling out to bins or down a chute or to a dumpster, and it's gone.
sentences.zh: 我们把垃圾和可回收物拿到垃圾桶、垃圾滑道或大垃圾箱里，它们就消失了。

sentences.en: We don't have to think about it.
sentences.zh: 我们不必去想它。

sentences.en: According to the EPA, Americans recycle and compost about 34% of their trash, which is less than most rich countries.
sentences.zh: 根据美国环保署的数据，美国人回收和堆肥的垃圾约占其垃圾的34%，这比大多数富裕国家都要少。

sentences.en: But some American cities do a lot better.
sentences.zh: 但一些美国城市做得好得多。

sentences.en: San Francisco has probably the most forward recycling program in North America.
sentences.zh: 旧金山可能拥有北美最前沿的回收计划。

sentences.en: This is Robert Reed.
sentences.zh: 这是罗伯特·里德。

sentences.en: He's the representative of Recology, the company that takes care of San Francisco's waste, recycling, and compoSt.
sentences.zh: 他是负责旧金山垃圾、回收和堆肥的公司Recology的代表。

sentences.en: Unlike Taipei, which has a public trash pickup system, many waste pickup services in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 与拥有公共垃圾收集系统的台北不同，美国的许多垃圾收集服务是私营公司，而我们是客户。

sentences.en: are private companies, and we are the customers.
sentences.zh: 这就是Recology的运作方式，这意味着他们必须让客户满意。

sentences.en: That's how it works with Recology, which means they've got to keep their customers happy.
sentences.zh: 我们的首要任务是提供卓越的客户服务。

sentences.en: Our number one focus is to provide superior customer service.
sentences.zh: 我们的下一个重点是尽可能多地进行回收，并让客户回收变得简单方便。

sentences.en: And our next focus is to do as much recycling as possible and to make recycling easy and convenient for customers.
sentences.zh: Recology设立了类似于台北系统的激励机制，即垃圾收集的费用比回收或堆肥收集贵得多。

sentences.en: Recology has set up similar incentives to the system in Taipei, where trash pickup is way more expensive than recycling or compost pickup.
sentences.zh: 例如，在旧金山，回收和堆肥每个垃圾桶每月花费约2美元。

sentences.en: For example, in San Francisco, recycling and compost cost about $2 a month per bin.
sentences.zh: 垃圾每个垃圾桶每月约26美元。

sentences.en: Trash is about $26 a month per bin.
sentences.zh: 但最重要的是，Recology的系统旨在简单且无压力。

sentences.en: But above all, Recology's system is meant to be simple and stress-free.
sentences.zh: 如果你想让人们继续为你的服务付费，它必须如此。

sentences.en: It has to be if you want people to keep paying for your service.
sentences.zh: 人们的生活中有许多需求。

sentences.en: People have a lot of demands in their lives.
sentences.zh: 我们理解这一点。

sentences.en: We understand that.
sentences.zh: 你知道，回收可能不是最重要的事情。

sentences.en: You know, recycling might not be the very first thing.
sentences.zh: 他们得让老板高兴。

sentences.en: They've got to make their boss happy.
sentences.zh: 他们得付房贷。

sentences.en: They've got to pay their mortgage.
sentences.zh: 垃圾、回收和堆肥可能并不总是排在清单的最前面。

sentences.en: Garbage and recycling and composting might not always be at the top of the liSt.
sentences.zh: 我们理解这一点。

sentences.en: We understand that.
sentences.zh: 基本上，Recology没有把自行分离不同种类堆肥和回收物的责任强加给市民，

sentences.en: Basically, instead of putting the onus on the citizens to separate the different kinds of compost and recycling for themselves,
sentences.zh: 而是承担了大部分工作。

sentences.en: Recology does the brunt of the work.
sentences.zh: 进行分类，这样我们就不用做了。

sentences.en: Sorting so we don't have to.
sentences.zh: 旧金山和许多其他收集可回收物的美国城市一样，使用一个大而全的回收桶。

sentences.en: San Francisco, like a lot of other American cities that collect recycling, uses one catch-all recycling bin.
sentences.zh: 所以你把罐子、瓶子、纸板都扔在同一个地方。

sentences.en: So you throw your cans, your bottles, your cardboard, all in the same place.
sentences.zh: 然后所有这些不同的材料最终都会到达像“回收中心”这样的设施。

sentences.en: And then all those different materials end up in a facility like Recycle Central.
sentences.zh: 所以这就是回收中心。

sentences.en: So this is Recycle Central.
sentences.zh: 所以这就是回收中心。

sentences.en: This is the large recycling plant on Pier 96, where we sort all the materials from the blue bin, the bottles, the cans, and the paper.
sentences.zh: 这里是位于96号码头的大型回收厂，我们在这里分类处理来自蓝色垃圾桶的所有材料：瓶子、罐子和纸张。

sentences.en: We're going to go inside now.
sentences.zh: 我们现在要进里面去。

sentences.en: The facility is massive, and it's where Recology processes most of San Francisco's recycling.
sentences.zh: 这个设施非常庞大，里科洛吉公司就是在这里处理旧金山大部分回收物的。

sentences.en: You can see this great big pile of recycling.
sentences.zh: 你可以看到这一大堆回收物。

sentences.en: This is from this morning.
sentences.zh: 这是今天早上的。

sentences.en: This is from one day.
sentences.zh: 这是一天的量。

sentences.en: And we're going to get this sorted out because we've got another big pile coming in tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 我们得把这些分类好，因为明天还有一大堆要运来。

sentences.en: So we do 600 tons a day here.
sentences.zh: 所以我们这里每天处理600吨。

sentences.en: That 600-ton pile will wind its way up a huge, surreal web of conveyor belts,
sentences.zh: 这600吨的垃圾将顺着一条巨大而超现实的传送带网络蜿蜒而上，

sentences.en: where some of the 173 people on staff will separate the recyclables into 16 categories of materials,
sentences.zh: 在173名员工中的一部分人的操作下，借助一些现代化的回收设备，

sentences.en: with the help of some modern recycling equipment.
sentences.zh: 将可回收物分拣为16种材料。

sentences.en: So we've got magnets, and we have fish ladders that separate bottles and cans from paper.
sentences.zh: 这里有磁铁，还有能把瓶罐和纸张分开的鱼梯式分选机。

sentences.en: They're on an angle, and they temporarily suspend gravity.
sentences.zh: 它们是有倾角的，能暂时打破重力。

sentences.en: And to make sure everything gets precisely sorted, there's some real state-of-the-art technology,
sentences.zh: 为了确保每样东西都能精确分拣，这里还配备了一些最先进的技术，

sentences.en: like this apparatus that separates clear plastic from color plastic with optic sensors.
sentences.zh: 比如这个利用光学传感器将透明塑料和彩色塑料分开的装置。

sentences.en: Right here, the scanner is looking at the materials as they come by,
sentences.zh: 就在这里，扫描仪正在检视流经的材料，

sentences.en: and when it sees a clear plastic, like a clear plastic water bottle,
sentences.zh: 当它看到透明塑料时，比如透明塑料水瓶，

sentences.en: it hits it with a puff of air, and you can hear it.
sentences.zh: 就会用一股气流击中它，你还能听到声音。

sentences.en: It's expensive.
sentences.zh: 这可不便宜。

sentences.en: It costs $3 million for this machine, and it came from the Netherlands.
sentences.zh: 这台机器价值300万美元，是从荷兰进口的。

sentences.en: So this system, with all of its whirring, twirling conveyors and magnets and machinery and 173 employees,
sentences.zh: 所以这个系统，有着嗡嗡作响、旋转的传送带、磁铁、机械以及173名员工，

sentences.en: it's dazzling.
sentences.zh: 真是令人眼花缭乱。

sentences.en: It makes less trash by doing more recycling.
sentences.zh: 它通过做得更多、更好的回收来减少垃圾。

sentences.en: And recycling creates 10 times more jobs than landfilling or incineration.
sentences.zh: 而且回收创造的就业机会是填埋或焚烧的10倍。

sentences.en: Of course, it also takes all the direct sorting out of the hands of the people who actually create the waste,
sentences.zh: 当然，这也把直接分拣的工作从真正产生垃圾的人手中剥夺了，

sentences.en: and charges them for the service instead.
sentences.zh: 转而为这项服务向他们收费。

sentences.en: As a result, recycling in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 结果就是，在美国，回收利用

sentences.en: can be expensive.
sentences.zh: 可能会很昂贵。

sentences.en: I guess that's part of the problem.
sentences.zh: 我想这就是问题所在吧。

sentences.en: Like, to the extent that there's pushback in recycling, which I've seen some of in the United States now,
sentences.zh: 比如说，就回收受到的阻力而言，我最近在美国也见了一些，

sentences.en: it's often about the cost of it, and how it's very costly.
sentences.zh: 往往是因为它的成本，而且非常昂贵。

sentences.en: And that's true if you're using the single-stream processes function,
sentences.zh: 如果你使用的是混合回收流程，确实如此，

sentences.en: and it's less true if the household does the separating.
sentences.zh: 但如果是家庭自己分类，就没那么贵了。

sentences.en: That's Professor Mary Alice Haddad again.
sentences.zh: 这位又是玛丽·爱丽丝·哈达德教授。

sentences.en: If your community wants to recycle, all that stuff needs to be separated and sorted.
sentences.zh: 如果你们社区想要回收，所有这些东西都需要被分离和分拣。

sentences.en: Somehow.
sentences.zh: 总得想办法。

sentences.en: Whether you use a $3 million machine from the Netherlands,
sentences.zh: 不管是使用来自荷兰的300万美元机器，

sentences.en: or compel an entire sweet potato-shaped island of people to stand on the corner at night.
sentences.zh: 还是动员全岛像红薯一样形状的人们大晚上站在街角。

sentences.en: The Taipei system is cheap and efficient because the city has conscripted their citizens as workers.
sentences.zh: 台北的系统之所以廉价且高效，是因为这座城市把市民征召成了工人。

sentences.en: And it's been successful.
sentences.zh: 而且它成功了。

sentences.en: Taipei is a great example of a big, major, global metropolitan area
sentences.zh: 台北是一个很好的例子，它是一个庞大的、主要的全球化大都市，

sentences.en: that did not have a good garbage collection system not that long ago.
sentences.zh: 不久前还没有一个好的垃圾收集系统。

sentences.en: And they have completely transformed.
sentences.zh: 而他们已经彻底蜕变了。

sentences.en: And it could be an example for us all.
sentences.zh: 这可以成为我们所有人的榜样。

sentences.en: Which is not to say we should necessarily copy Taipei's system.
sentences.zh: 这并不是说我们一定要照搬台北的系统。

sentences.en: What's worked for them might not work for the U.S.
sentences.zh: 对他们有效的方法可能对美国并不适用。

sentences.en: But consider the American garbage truck.
sentences.zh: 但想想美国的垃圾车吧。

sentences.en: Creeping around at dawn or during work hours,
sentences.zh: 在黎明或工作时间蹑手蹑脚地行驶，

sentences.en: trying to be as inconspicuous as possible.
sentences.zh: 尽量做到不引人注目。

sentences.en: Trying to keep trash out of sight and out of mind.
sentences.zh: 试图让垃圾眼不见心不烦。

sentences.en: You don't really pay attention to it.
sentences.zh: 你其实并不会过多关注它。

sentences.en: But everyone should pay a lot of attention.
sentences.zh: 但每个人都应该多多关注。

sentences.en: If we had to watch our garbage pile up in our homes without taking it out to the bin,
sentences.zh: 如果我们不得不看着垃圾在家里堆积而不把它拿出去倒掉，

sentences.en: and had to set aside time in our days to catch the garbage and recycling trucks coming down the street,
sentences.zh: 不得不腾出时间去赶街上的垃圾车和回收车，

sentences.en: I bet we'd produce less junk.
sentences.zh: 我敢说我们产生的垃圾会变少。

sentences.en: But I also think if I had to hear this song twice a night, five days a week,
sentences.zh: 但我也觉得，如果我一周五天、一天听两次这首歌，

sentences.en: I would murder everybody.
sentences.zh: 我会把所有人都杀了。

sentences.en: If you like that story, there are like 300 more episodes just like it in the archives.
sentences.zh: 如果你喜欢这个故事，档案里还有大约300个像这样的剧集。

sentences.en: Even if you read the description and the title and you think,
sentences.zh: 即使你看了简介和标题觉得，

sentences.en: well, I'm not really into that,
sentences.zh: 嗯，我对这个其实不太感兴趣，

sentences.en: download it and listen to it anyway.
sentences.zh: 也请下载并听一下。

sentences.en: Because this show is about making everyday things interesting.
sentences.zh: 因为这个节目讲的是让日常生活中的事物变得有趣。

sentences.en: So take the leap and go for it.
sentences.zh: 所以勇敢去听吧。
